propositions: Close must run attestation-verified plan-review check before completion verification when enforcement is enabled, blocking tickets whose own plan or pinned upstream plan changed during execution.
CLOSE profile disables code freshness validation but retains signature, reopen, registry, own-material, pin enforcement (when enabled), and phase compatibility checks.
The gate runs as a pure local read under the existing transaction lock immediately after structural checks and before STATUS append, with no model/network calls and fail-closed exception handling.
Unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility always block; pin issues block only when pin enforcement is enabled.
Pre-existing scope exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and non-empty force-close reason bypass the gate without double-locking or invalidating child-closure rules.
